info.name: PSAAS Admin Portal
info.description: PSAAS Admin Portal API. Run the whole collection in order: it creates its own tenant, plan, user, view and communication with unique names, captures their ids, and checks the expected status of every request. Set token, or keycloakUrl + clientId + clientSecret to get one with client credentials.

exec: // One run = one set of unique values (company name, VAT, PEC, emails, plan code), so the collection can run again.
// Settings read from any scope (environment, collection). No token: client credentials of adminportal-api against Keycloak (the service account needs the Administrator role).

body.raw:
{
  "code": "pm-{{runId}}",
  "name": "Pro {{runId}}",
  "description": "Per le aziende con più stabilimenti",
  "price": 1490,
  "billingPeriod": "Yearly",
  "trialDays": 30,
  "maxUsers": 100,
  "maxProductiveUnits": 10,
  "moduleIds": [
    "warehouse"
  ],
  "active": true
}

exec: if (pm.response.code < 300) { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('planId', json.id); }
if (pm.response.code < 300) { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('tenantId', json.id); }
if (pm.response.code < 300) { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('profileId', json.profiles[0].id); }
if (pm.response.code < 300) { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('draftId', json.id); }

item.name: UC21 List with filters and sort

request.description: 200 when the module had failed and is retried; 400 (moduleId InvalidValue) when it is already active.

exec: if (pm.response.code < 300) { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('userId', json.id); }

request.description: 409 here: the user has not activated the account yet (UC19 4a).

exec: if (pm.response.code < 300) { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('savedViewId', json.id); }

item.name: UC24 List invoices of the tenant

exec: if (pm.response.code < 300) { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('invoiceId', json.items[0].id); }

request.description: 409 here: a paid invoice cannot be cancelled (UC24 5a); on an open invoice it answers 200 with the credit note.
Modules call it with their own service account (role UsageReporter); an Administrator token works too.
409 here: the run user has not activated the account (or impersonation is not configured); 200 { url, expiresAt } for an active user.
